metadata.description: Front Door profile name.
Front Door endpoint name. Azure appends a hash to form <name>-<hash>.z01.azurefd.net.
WAF policy name. Letters and digits only, starting with a letter.
Origins in failover order: the first entry is priority 1 (active), the next priority 2 (standby). Each entry: { name, appServiceId, hostName, location }.
Relative path Front Door probes on every origin (the App Service health check path).
Custom domain served by the endpoint, for example app.example.com. Empty serves only the azurefd.net hostname.
Requests per minute from one client IP before the WAF blocks it.
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes allowed to reach the app. Empty disables geo-filtering.
